title.en: The alphabet — a kingdom of letters

recall.uz: Alifbo — maʼlum tartibda joylashgan harflar ketma-ketligi. Oʻzbek alifbosida 29 ta harf, 3 ta harf birikmasi (ch, sh, ng) va 1 ta tutuq belgisi (ʼ) bor. Harf soʻzning boshida, oʻrtasida yoki oxirida kelishi mumkin.
recall.ru: Алфавит — это последовательность букв в определённом порядке. В узбекском алфавите 29 букв, 3 буквосочетания (ch, sh, ng) и 1 знак тутук (ʼ). Буква может стоять в начале, середине или конце слова.
recall.en: The alphabet is a sequence of letters in a set order. Uzbek has 29 letters, 3 letter-combinations (ch, sh, ng) and 1 tutuq sign (ʼ). A letter can stand at the start, middle or end of a word.

hint.uz: Harflar: a, l, i, f, b, o.
hint.ru: Буквы: a, l, i, f, b, o.
hint.en: Letters: a, l, i, f, b, o.

explanation.en: “Alifbo” (alphabet) is a set order of letters.

hint.uz: Harflar: t, a, r, t, i, b.
hint.ru: Буквы: t, a, r, t, i, b.
hint.en: Letters: t, a, r, t, i, b.

explanation.uz: «olma» «o» harfi bilan boshlanadi. Harf soʻz boshida keldi.
explanation.ru: «olma» начинается с «o». Буква стоит в начале слова.
explanation.en: “olma” starts with “o”. The letter stands at the word's start.

hint.uz: ch, sh, ng — ikki belgidan iborat birikma.
hint.ru: ch, sh, ng — сочетания из двух знаков.
hint.en: ch, sh, ng are two-sign combinations.

explanation.uz: Alifboda 3 ta harf birikmasi bor: ch, sh, ng.
explanation.ru: В алфавите 3 буквосочетания: ch, sh, ng.
explanation.en: The alphabet has 3 letter-combinations: ch, sh, ng.

prompt.ru: Соедини букву с её местом в алфавите!
prompt.en: Match each letter to its place in the alphabet!

explanation.uz: Alifboda A — 1-, B — 2-, D — 3-, E — 4- harf.
explanation.ru: В алфавите A — 1-я, B — 2-я, D — 3-я, E — 4-я буква.
explanation.en: In the alphabet A is 1st, B 2nd, D 3rd, E 4th.

prompt.uz: Bir harfni olib tashlab, yangi soʻzga ula!
prompt.ru: Убери одну букву и соедини с новым словом!
prompt.en: Remove one letter and match the new word!

explanation.uz: Bitta harfni olib tashlasak, yangi soʻz hosil boʻladi.
explanation.ru: Убрав одну букву, получаем новое слово.
explanation.en: Removing one letter makes a new word.
We write letters in alphabetical order.

clue.en: The place where we get knowledge

explanation.uz: m + a + k + t + a + b = «maktab». Harf soʻz oʻrtasida keldi.
explanation.ru: m + a + k + t + a + b = «maktab». Буква стоит в середине.
explanation.en: m + a + k + t + a + b = “maktab”. The letter stands in the middle.

prompt.en: How many letters are in the Uzbek alphabet?

hint.uz: Tovushlar 30 ta, harflar undan bitta kam.
hint.en: There are 30 sounds; one fewer letters.
A combination is made of two signs.

explanation.uz: Alifboda 3 ta birikma (ch, sh, ng) va 1 ta tutuq belgisi (ʼ) bor.
explanation.ru: В алфавите 3 сочетания (ch, sh, ng) и 1 знак тутук (ʼ).
explanation.en: The alphabet has 3 combinations (ch, sh, ng) and 1 tutuq sign (ʼ).
